name: skill-name-provenance-check
description: Use before you recommend, install, fetch or clone a skill, plugin, MCP server, chipset or package by NAME when that name came from model recall (yours or another agent's) or from a user's unverified guess, and not from a registry listing or tool result read in this session. Models invent installable names, repeat the same invented names, and an attacker can register them first. Look the exact name up in the authoritative listing, refuse to pass on a name that is not there, check publisher and age for a name that is, install by pinned reference from the listing, and then hand the file to skill-injection-guardian. Distinct from skill-injection-guardian (the content of a file you already hold) and detect-conflicts (overlap between installed skills). Backed by the skill name hallucination measurement (arxiv 2607.12340). Triggers on recommending or installing a skill or package by name.
